_what: Where a copy of every form submission goes, so submissions can be approved instead of living only in an inbox. Paste ref/forms/submissions.gs into script.google.com, deploy it as a web app, and put the /exec URL here. Empty means the site only emails, as before. Ines approves people by tapping on the approval page, whose rows mirror ref/people.json.
_deployed: Deployed 2026-09-21 as the web app 'site forms' on the Apps Script project 'Tanit XR site submissions', executing as inessaid88@gmail.com with access set to Anyone. If submissions.gs changes, redeploy with Manage deployments and Version: New version, or the old code keeps running.
